_om: Murbrekkeren in English: Wallop. British English; key = the Norwegian text (rusj/SPRAK.md).
Slipp fingeren for å skyte: Lift your finger to send the ball
Here they come again – a little faster.
Send ballen opp mot muren og knus alle k: Send the ball up at the wall and smash every brick. The paddle at the bottom has to stop the ball falling out.
Dra fingeren hvor som helst på brettet –: Slide your finger anywhere on the board – below it too – and the paddle follows. On a keyboard: the arrow keys.
Slipp fingeren, så går ballen. Med tasta: Lift your finger and the ball goes. On a keyboard: space.
Når alle klossene er borte, er brettet k: When every brick is gone, the level is cleared. You have three balls – lose them all and the game is over.
Der ballen treffer racketen, bestemmer r: Where the ball hits the paddle decides where it goes: in the middle it goes straight up, near the ends it flies off at an angle.
Mørke klosser tåler to treff. Stål går a: Dark bricks take two hits. Steel never breaks – aim past it.
Klosser med en stjerne slipper en kapsel: Bricks with a star drop a capsule. Catch it with the paddle: a wide paddle, three balls, a slow ball or an extra ball.
Brettene du har kommet til, kan du start: You can start again on any level you have reached with ‘Choose level’.
Spillet tar pause av seg selv hvis du by: The game pauses by itself if you switch apps. On a keyboard, P or Esc pauses.
Murbrekkeren går i sanntid og kan dessve: Wallop runs in real time and sadly can't be played with a screen reader.
A paddle, a ball and a wall that has to come down.
Hvor mange brett klarer du?: How many levels can you clear?
Du kan starte på alle brettene du har ko: You can start on any level you have reached.
Brettet med muren, ballen og racketen: The board with the wall, the ball and the paddle
Dra hvor som helst for å styre – slipp f: Drag anywhere to steer – let go to send the ball.
Piltaster styrer · mellomrom skyter · P: Arrow keys steer · space sends · P = pause
